readiness_semantics.Verified: the exact planned identity is installed on the named target host, has retained evidence and passed a functional check
readiness_semantics.Missing: no target-host evidence exists; sandbox observations, if any, are listed under `observed` and do not count
readiness_semantics.Conflicting: target-host or sandbox evidence contradicts the planned identity, or the identity itself is unresolved
readiness_semantics.note: Version and required-capability pins decide Verified; build digests (FFmpeg capability, MLT service catalog) are recorded as observed facts of a host build and are not pinned (operator decision D11, 2026-10-21).
